svg.title: B08 displayed-data fixed-plan disturbance tube
svg.desc: For fixed plan (0.3, 0.6, 0.6, -0.6), each stage shows every disturbance-corner history projected from the four-state model onto oxidizer flow x1 and fuel flow x3. The stage-four panel marks worst disturbance signs +−+−+−+− and the projected target.
svg.text: B08 L04 disturbance tube — fixed plan (0.3, 0.6, 0.6, -0.6)
All corner histories at each stage, projected from the four-state model; panels use shared bounds.
